identity_note: Matched UnifyCX (unifycx.com), the Louisville, KY customer-experience BPO formerly GlowTouch. Not to be confused with Unify (German unified-communications firm bought by Mitel from Atos) or 'Tregaron India Holdings dba Unify' named in Aura Consolidated Group's 2026 S-1, which the filings do not tie to UnifyCX.

profile.name: UnifyCX
profile.description: Global customer-experience outsourcing (BPO) company that pairs AI tooling with human agents for customer support, technical support, healthcare billing and back-office work for enterprise clients.
profile.location: Louisville, KY (US HQ per PitchBook and press datelines); delivery sites in the US (KY, TX, MA, FL), Colombia, Honduras, Dominican Republic, India, Philippines and South Africa
profile.year_founded: 2002 (as GlowTouch; some third-party profiles say 2001); rebranded UnifyCX Nov 2024
profile.funding_detail: Private; PitchBook classifies it as private-equity-backed. Company site says UnifyCX was created 'with WndrCo' (Jeffrey Katzenberg's holding company); WndrCo's stake and any amounts are undisclosed.
profile.headcount: ~2,200-2,500 (Built In 2,213; PitchBook ~2,500); Latka-type estimates as low as ~1,100
profile.past_completed_deals: GlowTouch acquired Collective Solution (Los Angeles call-center provider, founded 2002) in 2024; the combined business was rebranded UnifyCX (launched Nov 4, 2024; sale-completion announcement by Intrepid dated Dec 2024). No acquisitions found since.
profile.open_role: No corp-dev roles; hiring Operations, Customer Service, Healthcare Billing, QA, Finance (Global Consolidation & Financial Reporting Manager, Senior Tax Accountant), Engineering and Legal (Corporate Paralegal) (34 open roles) as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: One formative acquisition (2024) · no corp dev seat open
verdict.detail: Growth since the Collective Solution deal has been organic site launches (Quezon City 2025, South Africa Jun 2026); founder-CEO Vidya Ravichandran controls strategy.
